description.value: A 55-plus RV resort on a private beachfront lot alongside Highway 19A just south of Campbell River, with full hookups, heated washrooms, and coastal mountain views; no tent camping is offered and the park trends toward longer-stay residents.

address.value: 3860 S Island Hwy, Campbell River, BC V9H 1M5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and richly confirms the OSM record. The RV Park subpage explicitly states 'Ages 55+ Only,' which is a critical restriction for general touring cyclists. Showers ('heated washrooms, showers'), coin laundry, and free WiFi are confirmed directly on the RV Park page; the cottages page confirms kayak availability and AirBnB-based reservations, while the RV park page includes a 'Reserve Now' button.
concerns: RV park states 'Ages 55+ Only' — this restriction may make the camping component unsuitable for a general touring cyclist audience.
No tent camping or dedicated hiker/biker sites mentioned anywhere on the website.
OSM address ('3860 South Island Highway') lacks city, province, and postal code; website provides the more complete form ('3860 S Island Hwy, Campbell River, BC V9H 1M5') used here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The RV park is explicitly restricted to 'Ages 55+ Only,' which would exclude many touring cyclists; the cottages have no stated age restriction but are priced as full holiday suites rather than budget cyclist accommodation, and no tent or hiker/biker sites are mentioned.
enrichment_extras.notes: The beachfront cottages (booked via AirBnB) are available to all ages and include free WiFi and kayaks, but are positioned as luxury holiday suites rather than cyclist-friendly accommodation. If the directory scope includes upscale lodging options, the cottages may warrant a separate review.
